correctness.rationale: The source generating function is applied exactly. Weighted blocks sum to 3/4; Catalan tails have a rigorously derived inverse-three-halves law; after a linear part cutoff every admissible long composition has at least two blocks of linear size. Fixed-block sums converge to the two-block beta-type integral above half depth, and zero at or below half. Contributions with three blocks above K vanish after K→∞. The uniform m^5(3/4)^(m-2) bound justifies dominated summation. The integral evaluates to 4(2alpha−1)/sqrt(alpha(1−alpha)), and the geometric pair sum is 64. Checker exact table: 55; exact composition identity: 66; normalized numerical diagnostics and two-block limit: passed. No finite test is presented as proof of the infinite statement.
